name: Commerce Iranian Payment Pack
description: A collection of Iranian bank payment gateways for Drupal Commerce (server-side transaction verification).
project_description:
This module provides some payment gateways for Iranian Banks.

 Back to top 

 Supported Banks / Gateways: 
 Currently the following Banks are supported:

 
 MellatBank 
 Melli Bank 
 ZarinPal 
 Zibal 
 Pasargad 
 Saman Bank 
 Saderat Bank
